name: foreground-child-watchdog
note: Originally a FALSE POSITIVE from the 2026-07-19 MCP scan (xmcp@0.6.13): the `foreground-child` zombie-reaper spawns `node -e <static watchdog>` that kills the child if the parent dies on SIGHUP — a fixed, inlined script with no attacker input, used by many CLIs. pkgxray read the spawned `node -e` (with the expected stdio:'ignore') as a silent stage-2 executor. FIXED: inspectHiddenNodeExec now recognises the reaper signature (NODE_REAPER_WATCHDOG_REGEX: process.on(SIG*) -> process.kill) and exempts it when the file carries no stage-2 payload primitive (NODE_EXEC_STAGE2_PAYLOAD_REGEX: network/eval/dynamic-require/decode/fs-write/download). The child_process.spawn is still surfaced at INFO (code-execution) but no longer gates. A watchdog that also fetches or evals still BLOCKs.
